title: trichilia arborescens
intro: Trichilia arborescens, commonly known as the West Indian Mastwood, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. The West Indian Mastwood is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Trichilia arborescens include its ability to treat fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
